title: Structural storage keys in the M3 model (the Q21 fix): mapping storage keyed as (base slot, key path) instead of a lookup in the law's keccak256 table, the deployment converted, the evaluator mapping keys to real slots only against real traces and in replay, a generated keys check, A-keccak-structural in the ledger, and the proof routes the store opens (SK frames, key split, convoy, loop frames, bit-field lemmas, tag_exact)

predictions.claim: R5 on the structural typed model: holon fragments with it as the step evaluator compares I20's corpus (460 traces, 3013 steps, 8894 storage comparisons) with 0 disagreements and 0 unexplained, I20's statuses per action and I20's panics (0x11 at Rollup.sol:363 on 27 steps, :368 on 2, :439 on 2, :636 on 6), its evaluator_sha256 the committed model's. It fails if the canonical form has a hole: two compiler-generated accesses to one real slot compiled to different keys, or a key cleaned differently from solc's hashing.

The keys check is clean: gen/M3/sorts/keys.json lists the two raw slots (EIP-1967 implementation and admin), the 9 literal and 7 structural s0 entries and every structural key the R5 corpus and the committed witnesses and inhabitants of the M3 typed records (rule S11) touch, each real slot as the instrument computes it, and no collision.

The toy T30: L_sort_tag_toytypes_83_33f98e53 is PROVED by tag_exact (a Reach induction of the kept-register invariant over the structural store) with a checked, reachable inhabitant, and the other four toy laws and the keepg-guard mutation are decided as I30 designed (REFUTED at recommit, commitT and commitQ; PROVED by coercion_guard at elapsed; the mutation REFUTED through keepg): I30's TestToy.test_toy_statuses and test_toy_kept_register_without_its_version_guard_is_refuted pass.

DISCH: the 14 laws of thresholds.flips are PROVED, each accepted attempt a proof checked by bend2 and BendTT: blk_pausableupgradeable_77 x3 and blk_rollup_132 x4 (frames by evaluation and key splits over SK), blk_initializable_120 TI3 and TI4 and blk_rollup_213 x2 (with loop frames), blk_rollup_228 (a key split with the convoy: finalizeBatch's store at finalizedStateRoots[_batchIndex] contradicts B at _batchIndex == 0 by the passed check), rev_rollup_363 (loop frames), and TI2 (bit-field lemmas over slot 0's packed _initialized update). L_disch_blk_rollup_363_e11d8bb2_anyone stays UNKNOWN, its record naming a monotone transport (finalizeBatch's delete of challenges[_batchIndex - 1] at B's family needs startTime := 0 to keep B); L_disch_blk_rollup_363_e11d8bb2_onlyActiveSubmitter stays REFUTED. DISCH totals: 27 PROVED, 7 REFUTED, 1 UNKNOWN (13, 7 and 15 at the prereg).

Non-vacuity: every law of thresholds.flips has a checked, reachable inhabitant, TI4's (L_disch_blk_initializable_120_d9a34b48_caller_rollup_210) included: since F40, initialize4 succeeds in one step from s0 and leaves _initialized == 4, as its rev twin's inhabitant at the prereg shows (the Q21 design note's 'TI4 unknown' predates F40).

G4: the M3 gate's DISCH G4 holds a disch_writer canary per PROVED DISCH blocking law with a named class (adding one non-X writer of its class), and every canary is rejected: I31's exit criterion met for the first time.
Every proof and counter-law of the 51 remade typed records checks in bend2 and BendTT within the per-file budget: no attempt stops on fuel or times out.

regressions.claim: No own commit changes a law file, REGISTRY.json or DERIVATION.json under laws/, a file under gen/M3/laws/, a LAWS.bend or the rule catalog: the typed laws' statements are byte-identical; laws/STATEMENT_DIFF.jsonl only gains remodel lines (R7), and no catalog_rederivation line is needed.

Every typed M3 law outside thresholds.flips keeps its status at the prereg (SORT 279 and 363 REFUTED, 406 UNKNOWN; DISCH ext x6 PROVED, noext x6 REFUTED, rev x7 PROVED, blk_363_onlyActiveSubmitter REFUTED, blk_363_anyone UNKNOWN; UNDO 3 REFUTED, 5 UNKNOWN; FACT 4 REFUTED, 1 PROVED), every REFUTED one with a replay that passed; a typed law another key adds before the run (rule S11) keeps the status its record had before I68 remade it.

Each own commit that changes a record of results/M0-M2, results/T32 or a PAR record of results/M3 leaves it equal to its parent's version but for generator_sha256 and keys named seconds; no own commit changes gen/M0, gen/M1, gen/M2 or gen/M3/model/.

F32's eight helpers (w_eq, w_add, w_add_ok, w_sub, u_b4, u_be4, h_get, kw_set) have, in every structural model and section, exactly their text in the prelude at the prereg (holon.sorts.prelude3's PRELUDE), and spec/M2/ledger.json is unchanged.

A-keccak-structural is listed by every record over the typed model or a section (the 51 typed laws, and any typed law of rule S11 another key adds: SORT and DISCH in model_assumptions, UNDO and FACT in ledger_assumptions) and by no other record of results/M0-M3 or T32 (PAR laws, I28's records over its raw versioned machine); spec/M3/ledger.json introduces it by SK, sk_eq, sload and sstore.

Construction: the key pins the instrument and the contract docstring; the instrument classifies the Rollup's captured deployment as thresholds.s0 pins (9 literal, 7 structural, 2 raw), each structural slot the real slot of its key, with a clean keys check.

Rule S11: laws/STATEMENT_DIFF.jsonl gains one remodel entry per typed law of rule S11 (the 51, and any typed law another key adds before the run), each accepted by holon.statement_diff.check_entry and naming Q21, the model versions and A-keccak-structural; spec/bindings/M3.json binds them to the structural models, and CI's gate-M3-G2 accepts them.

I30-P8 keeps passing on the structural models: tests_m3/test_sort_types.py's TestTermSize.test_nominal_types_cost_at_most_the_frozen_ratio, run as it stands (the typed cone of the :363 realize law at most 1.5 times the untyped one; both models change their storage alike).

thresholds.disclosure: What was known before this commit. (1) The Q21 design note's outcomes are readings of the code and the committed records, not runs: its Bend probes were self-contained scratch files over the real prelude (the SK store, the frame library, five frame facts, and a Reach induction of a kept-register invariant on a two-action machine, each checked in bend2 and BendTT, planted errors failing), and no generator, refuter, gate or forge ran on the subject. (2) In this session, before this commit: the instrument classified the committed capture (9 literal, 7 structural, 2 raw; keys check clean); the 51 typed records' statuses and fields were read; the model's store, compiler, evaluator, search, DISCH routes, UNDO trace section and I28's versioned generator (PR #50's head, abb834b) were read; I30's TestTermSize.test_nominal_types_cost_at_most_the_frozen_ratio was run at the base (passed, 8 s), and I30's committed term_size.json was read (I30-P7's :363 law_terms 1107, red). (3) The independent prereg review was started and then stopped by the human's pause after about fifteen minutes, before it reported; the author's adversarial self-check replaced it (docs/iterations/I68_prereg_review.json, committed after this commit, with its fold). No build code for I68 exists at this commit, and no M3 model with structural keys was built or run.
